text:
marie: Drafting a different take on the console IA: instead of renaming to 'Assets', keep separate 'Models' and 'Datasets' visually but collapse them into a single collapsible group that still surfaces a breadcrumb trail above the canvas. The idea: compact left rail + persistent breadcrumb path so deep links show full context. Mock: https://staging.redwood/design/breadcrumb-focused-ia.png

kai: I like preserving discoverability by keeping both labels visible in the breadcrumb. UX question: when a user lands on `/console/w/acme/models/123`, should the leftrail auto-expand to show the Models child and highlight the item? I think yes, and the breadcrumb should read: "Workspace • Models • ModelName" with each segment deep-linkable.

sam: Routing implications: we need canonical paths that mirror the breadcrumb. Proposed canonical: `/console/w/:org/:collection(models|datasets)/:id`. For compact group UX, we can implement a client-side alias `/console/w/:org/assets/:type/:id` that maps to the canonical route without breaking permalinks. Redirect strategy: server-side 301 for legacy `/models/:id` -> `/console/w/:org/models/:id`. Also keep shortlinks `/m/:id` as 302 during transition. Important: when route changes, emit an event to preserve scroll anchor and breadcrumb focus so screen readers don't lose context.

rachel: Accessibility notes: breadcrumbs must use nav with `aria-label=\"Breadcrumb\"` and the last item gets `aria-current=\"page\"`. When the left group auto-expands on route load, announce via live region: "Models section expanded". Keyboard expectations: focusable breadcrumb links, skip link to "Main content" that lands at the page canvas, and when expanding the group, move focus to the first child if the expansion was user-initiated. For programmatic expand on route load, do not steal focus; just reveal.

marie: Copy & microcopy: prefer explicit breadcrumb segment labels rather than truncating. For long model names, show a short name in the breadcrumb with full name tooltip. Also add a small chevron indicator on the group header that reads "Models + Datasets" on hover for newcomers.

kai: Deep-link example we should support: `/console/w/acme/models/123#metrics?panel=insights`. Note: hash anchors + query params order can be messy; we should standardize on querystring for UI state and reserve hash for scroll anchors only. So canonical deep link: `/console/w/acme/models/123?panel=insights&view=split#metrics`. Middleware should preserve both when rewriting legacy links.

sam: Implementation checklist: keep canonical routes simple, add client-side route aliases for `/assets/...` that rehydrate to canonical routes, normalize query params on redirect, and emit a `route:context-loaded` event after hydration so UI components (breadcrumbs, left rail) can sync without layout thrash. For anchors, use `scroll-behavior: smooth` and a debounce when applying scroll after hydration to avoid jumping during layout.

deploy-bot: preview: https://staging-console.redwood/preview/breadcrumb-ia-v1 (build 5123) :eyes:

rachel: Research plan: run a moderated task where users find a model from a permalink and another task where they land on a dataset via search. Measure time-to-find and whether they use leftrail vs breadcrumb vs search. Also test A11y with NVDA/VoiceOver for the live-region announcements.

marie: Action items:
- @sam: add server 301s for legacy top-level shortlinks, implement client alias mapping `/assets/*` -> canonical routes, emit `route:context-loaded` event after hydration, preserve querystring+hash on redirects.
- @kai: update mocks to show breadcrumb overflow behavior, tooltip copy, and the chevron microcopy.
- @rachel: write accessibility acceptance criteria: breadcrumb nav semantics, live-region wording, skiplink behavior, focus rules for user-initiated vs programmatic expansions.

marie: Target: cut an alpha to staging by next Tuesday. If anyone expects blockers speak up now. :thumbsup:

kai: Small copy tweak for the tooltip: "Contains Models and Datasets" -> shorter: "Models & Datasets".

sam: No infra blockers. I'll open a PR for redirects and the hydration event this afternoon.

rachel: I'll add keyboard testcases (breadcrumb tab order, skiplink, collapse/expand via keyboard) to the ticket and run a quick a11y smoke before the alpha.

marie: Thanks team. Pinning the mock and research plan.
